headline: As of 2026-10-11: 3,194,623 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+26.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,194,623 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+26.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (519,636), Florida (501,295), Michigan (386,495).
